correctness.rationale: The four Venn-cell counts (a,b,c,d) determine all inclusion/Some statements by their zero pattern; every cardinal comparison of p, not-p, q, not-q is a sign of u=b-c, v=a-d, u+v or v-u. Normalizing |u| and |v| into 0,1,2 while retaining relative magnitude and signs, and rebuilding pairs (b,c),(a,d) with original positivity, costs at most 4+|u|+|v|<=7 and preserves every sentence, even for infinite theories. Jiang’s unrestricted dichotomy supplies the upper spectrum family. Eleven explicit theories have exact minima 1..7,2,4,6, and size-extension operations supply every permitted later size. Independent enumeration of 7,314 nonempty four-cell models at sizes 1..18 finds 67 profiles, all minimal profile sizes at most 7 and some requiring 7; eleven witness theories independently checked at sizes 1..12. Finite checks corroborate, do not establish, the unlimited compression.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The unrestricted theorem restricts spectrum shapes but does not bound the minimum n uniformly by 7 when the two-noun language is fixed; an implication would require a separate quantitative normalization argument.

final_claim: For arbitrary theories in the two-raw-noun, complement-closed S^dagger(card) syllogistic (no Boolean sentence connectives), spectra of finite nonempty models are exactly the empty spectrum, all tails T_1 through T_7, and even tails E_2,E_4,E_6. Every realized sentence truth profile has a <=7-point representative; the threshold 7 is sharp.
